verifications.claim: Saturday Night Live UK (SNL UK) premieres in 2026 with 50 seasons.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Premieres: March 21, 2026 (R1); 'You can stream all 50 seasons of SNL, the US version, on Peacock' (R1); 'The inaugural season contains eight episodes' (R3); 'which will air eight episodes' (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Premiere date in 2026 supported, but 50 seasons attributed to US SNL, not SNL UK; SNL UK is new inaugural season with 8 episodes.

verifications.claim: SNL UK features live episodes on Sky One in the UK.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'Channel: Sky One and Now' (R1); 'aired on Sky One' (R2); 'premieres on Saturday, March 21 on SKY One and NOW in the UK' (R3); 'will air on Sky One in the UK' (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm live episodes on Sky One in UK.

verifications.claim: SNL UK features live episodes on Now TV in the UK.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'stream live for free on Sky One and streaming service Now' (R1); 'SKY One and NOW in the UK' (R3); 'stream the show through Now' (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly support live streaming on Now (Now TV) in UK.

verifications.claim: SNL UK live episodes air on Saturdays at 10 p.m. GMT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'Airs: Saturdays at 10 p.m. GMT' (R1); 'premieres on Saturday, March 21, at 10 p.m. GMT' (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of air time and day.

verifications.claim: SNL UK is available to stream on Peacock in the US one day after the original airing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'Peacock will drop episodes the next day' (R1); 'stream it on-demand the following day... on Peacock' (R3); 'available to stream on Peacock the day after they air in the UK' (R4)
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state one-day delay on Peacock in US.

verifications.claim: Key SNL UK sketches can be viewed on YouTube.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No references mention viewing key SNL UK sketches on YouTube; only a cast video on Sky YouTube (R1).
